content: Erik Ninn-Hansen was a Danish politician who served as Minister of Justice in Denmark during the 1980s and early 1990s. He was a member of the Conservative People's Party. In the early 1990s, he was involved in a significant political scandal related to the Tamil asylum seekers case, which led to his resignation and legal proceedings.
